Package com.peselgenerator.controller

Class PeselController

java.lang.Object
com.peselgenerator.controller.PeselController
@Controller public class PeselController extends Object
Controller for the protected dashboard area. Handles multiple PESEL generation, saving to database, file downloads, and email sending.
